description.value: False Creek Community Centre is a publicly operated civic facility on Granville Island, jointly managed by the Vancouver Park Board and the non-profit False Creek Community Association since 1980. It offers a broad range of programs including kayaking, canoeing, tennis, fitness classes, pottery, and performing arts for all ages. Located steps from Granville Island's public market and waterfront seawall, it sits along one of Vancouver's most popular cycling corridors.
